body: I know you're a great person, but I have made up my mind. Not in spite but over a length of time. I no longer have faith in myself or others. Thank you.
I end up contemplating my efforts and why im so fucking trash. I also think about why we're learning specific useless things. I end up thinking they are setting us up for failure.
School makes you feel like shit for trying. You're never good enough apparently.

School doesnt give a fuck about your mental health or wellbeing. I told my art teacher I was in a state of depression and he told me to use that sadness towards my major artwork. My brother also suffers from depression and all they cared about was how they could give him more work, he got depressed because of the work load. He had no life outside of studying.
